topic.title: Structured Visual Generation and Synthetic-Image Analysis
topic.overview: Visual generators must represent objects, geometry, and long-range scene relationships while producing convincing pixels. The central representatives study compositional latent variables, spatially modulated generators, inverse graphics, and score-based synthesis. Related detection work examines the space of generated images to understand where synthetic-image classifiers fail.
topic.whyItMatters: Good visual quality alone does not guarantee controllable geometry or broad coverage of possible outputs. Structured generation can make synthesis easier to interpret and manipulate, while systematic exploration of that structure can improve evaluation and detection.
topic.evolution: The collection begins with probabilistic image-generation and interpretation models. Later examples combine attention and style modulation to organize scenes and geometric variation. Recent work expands into multimodal flow-based synthesis and detector-guided exploration of generative space, reflecting complementary interests in producing images and understanding their distinctive failure modes.
openQuestions: How can generators preserve object relationships while allowing local edits?
Which generated variations are missing from standard sampling-based evaluations?

papers.title: Benchmarking and Analyzing 3D-aware Image Synthesis with a Modularized Codebase
papers.tldr: A modular codebase makes 3D-aware image generators easier to reproduce, compare, and analyze component by component.

papers.title: DatasetDM: Synthesizing Data with Perception Annotations Using Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: DatasetDM decodes diffusion-model representations into perception labels, enabling large synthetic training datasets from a small manually annotated starting set.

papers.title: Diverse Shape Completion via Style Modulated Generative Adversarial Networks
papers.tldr: A style-modulated generative network produces more diverse 3D shape completions while better preserving observed geometry, without multiple reference completions per input.

papers.title: Expanding Small-Scale Datasets with Guided Imagination
papers.tldr: GIF expands small labeled datasets with generated images guided to preserve class information and increase useful diversity.

papers.title: GenImage: A Million-Scale Benchmark for Detecting AI-Generated Image
papers.tldr: GenImage provides a million-scale dataset and tests for evaluating generated-image detectors across generators and degraded image conditions.

papers.title: Learning Modulated Transformation in GANs
papers.tldr: A plug-in GAN module learns latent-controlled spatial offsets so convolution can better model geometric variation.

papers.title: Learning Visual Prior via Generative Pre-Training
papers.tldr: VisorGPT learns visual layout priors from discrete sequences of boxes, poses, and masks, enabling prompt-guided sampling.

papers.title: PUG: Photorealistic and Semantically Controllable Synthetic Data for Representation Learning
papers.tldr: PUG uses Unreal Engine to create realistic, controllable synthetic images for more rigorous evaluation and improved model training.

papers.title: Revisiting the Evaluation of Image Synthesis with GANs
papers.tldr: The study develops a more consistent image-synthesis evaluation system using robust feature extractors and Centered Kernel Alignment.

papers.title: Semantic Image Synthesis with Unconditional Generator
papers.tldr: A semantic mapper and cross-attention rearranging network give pretrained unconditional generators detailed mask-based spatial control.

papers.title: StyleGAN knows Normal, Depth, Albedo, and More
papers.tldr: Fixed latent offsets let a pretrained StyleGAN generate intrinsic property maps that compare well with regression methods and resist relighting effects.

papers.title: E$^2$GAN: Efficient Training of Efficient GANs for Image-to-Image Translation
papers.tldr: E²GAN reduces the cost of creating mobile image-editing GANs through a reusable base model, selective LoRA adaptation, and data-efficient fine-tuning.

papers.title: GenCO: Generating Diverse Designs with Combinatorial Constraints
papers.tldr: GenCO trains generative models on solver-enforced feasible designs, combining hard combinatorial guarantees with diverse, high-quality outputs.

papers.title: Leverage Class-Specific Accuracy to Guide Data Generation for Improving Image Classification
papers.tldr: Needs-aware image generation allocates synthetic-data budgets using each class’s classification performance.

papers.title: Neural Image Compression with Text-guided Encoding for both Pixel-level and Perceptual Fidelity
papers.tldr: Text-guided encoding and joint image-text training improve image compression while preserving both perceptual and pixel-level fidelity.

papers.title: Position: What makes an image realistic?
papers.tldr: This position paper introduces universal critics as a theoretical guide to measuring realism, a problem that good generative models alone do not solve.

papers.title: StyDeSty: Min-Max Stylization and Destylization for Single Domain Generalization
papers.tldr: StyDeSty jointly learns to create style variation and remove its influence through a shared latent representation.

papers.title: An Image is Worth 32 Tokens for Reconstruction and Generation
papers.tldr: TiTok compresses images into short one-dimensional token sequences, enabling strong generation quality and substantial reported speedups.

papers.title: Color-Oriented Redundancy Reduction in Dataset Distillation
papers.tldr: Color-aware dataset distillation reduces redundant colors within images and repeated color patterns across images to improve condensed training data.

papers.title: Enhancing Consistency-Based Image Generation via Adversarialy-Trained Classification and Energy-Based Discrimination
papers.tldr: A jointly trained classifier and energy-based discriminator guide post-processing that improves the quality of consistency-generated images.

papers.title: Exploring DCN-like architecture for fast image generation with arbitrary resolution
papers.tldr: FlowDCN uses deformable convolutions for flexible-resolution image generation with linear time and memory complexity and strong reported efficiency.

papers.title: FashionR2R: Texture-preserving Rendered-to-Real Image Translation with Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: FashionR2R enhances rendered clothing images with diffusion models while using attention control to preserve fine garment textures.

papers.title: GenWarp: Single Image to Novel Views with Semantic-Preserving Generative Warping
papers.tldr: GenWarp integrates source-image information and geometric guidance so a generative model can learn where to warp and where to generate novel views.

papers.title: HairFastGAN: Realistic and Robust Hair Transfer with a Fast Encoder-Based Approach
papers.tldr: HairFast combines StyleGAN FS-space encoding, alignment, and inpainting for realistic hairstyle transfer in under a second on an Nvidia V100.

papers.title: Image Understanding Makes for A Good Tokenizer for Image Generation
papers.tldr: Training image tokenizers to reconstruct features from understanding models improves image generation across the evaluated settings.

papers.title: MaskFactory: Towards High-quality Synthetic Data Generation for Dichotomous Image Segmentation
papers.tldr: MaskFactory combines controlled mask editing with image generation to produce diverse, precise synthetic segmentation datasets.

papers.title: Rethinking Imbalance in Image Super-Resolution for Efficient Inference
papers.tldr: WBSR balances super-resolution training and adds dynamic inference, achieving comparable or better quality with about 34% less computation.

papers.title: Return of Unconditional Generation: A Self-supervised Representation Generation Method
papers.tldr: RCG generates self-supervised semantic representations to guide label-free image generation, reaching quality comparable to leading class-conditional methods.

papers.title: Self-Consuming Generative Models with Curated Data Provably Optimize Human Preferences
papers.tldr: Reward-based curation can make iterative generative-model retraining implicitly optimize preferences while amplifying the reward model's biases.

papers.title: Compositional Scene Understanding through Inverse Generative Modeling
papers.tldr: Compositional generative models infer scene properties by finding the conditions that best explain an image, with demonstrated generalization to unfamiliar scenes.

papers.title: Efficient Generative Modeling with Residual Vector Quantization-Based Tokens
papers.tldr: ResGen predicts collective token embeddings to improve generation quality without making inference-step counts grow with quantization depth.

papers.title: EQ-VAE: Equivariance Regularized Latent Space for Improved Generative Image Modeling
papers.tldr: EQ-VAE regularizes autoencoder representations to transform consistently with images, improving latent generation without degrading reconstruction quality.

papers.title: GMAIL: Generative Modality Alignment for generated Image Learning
papers.tldr: GMAIL improves learning from generated images by treating them as a separate modality and aligning their representations with real images.

papers.title: LightningDrag: Lightning Fast and Accurate Drag-based Image Editing Emerging from Videos
papers.tldr: LightningDrag learns transformations from video-frame pairs to deliver accurate drag-based image edits in about one second.

papers.title: Minimalist Concept Erasure in Generative Models
papers.tldr: This method optimizes concept erasure through final-output distributions and reports robust removal while preserving overall performance in evaluated flow-matching models.

papers.title: Normalizing Flows are Capable Generative Models
papers.tldr: TarFlow combines autoregressive Transformers with sample-quality improvements to achieve strong image likelihoods and generation comparable to diffusion models.

papers.title: PiD: Generalized AI-Generated Images Detection with Pixelwise Decomposition Residuals
papers.tldr: PiD extracts pixelwise quantization residuals to detect generated images, achieving reported accuracy of 98% on GenImage.

papers.title: RealRAG: Retrieval-augmented Realistic Image Generation via Self-reflective Contrastive Learning
papers.tldr: RealRAG trains a retriever to supply real-object images that fill a generator’s visual knowledge gaps and improve realistic image generation.

papers.title: Visual Generation Without Guidance
papers.tldr: Guidance-Free Training matches reported classifier-free guidance performance using single-model sampling and can be trained directly from scratch.

papers.title: A Geometry-Aware Metric for Mode Collapse in Time Series Generative Models
papers.tldr: DMD-GEN measures and interprets missing diversity in generated time series by comparing the geometry of their temporal dynamics.

papers.title: AR-RAG: Autoregressive Retrieval Augmentation for Image Generation
papers.tldr: AR-RAG improves image generation by retrieving and incorporating relevant visual patches throughout generation as the image develops.

papers.title: Creative Synthesis of Kinematic Mechanisms
papers.tldr: An image-generative approach designs planar linkages using visual representations of mechanisms, motion paths, and speed profiles.

papers.title: Denoising Trajectory Biases for Zero-Shot AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.tldr: Differences in how quickly diffusion denoising approaches an image provide a zero-shot signal for detecting AI-generated content.

papers.title: Detecting Generated Images by Fitting Natural Image Distributions
papers.tldr: The detector identifies generated images through geometric transformations that change a natural-image model's loss, with normalizing flows amplifying distribution differences.

papers.title: Diff-ICMH: Harmonizing Machine and Human Vision in Image Compression with Generative Prior
papers.tldr: Diff-ICMH combines diffusion priors, semantic consistency, and compact tag guidance to compress images for both human viewing and machine analysis.

papers.title: Discovering Latent Graphs with GFlowNets for Diverse Conditional Image Generation
papers.tldr: A GFlowNet-based latent graph turns uncertain image conditions into varied representations, improving diversity and fidelity in reported evaluations.

papers.title: Distilled Decoding 2: One-step Sampling of Image Auto-regressive Models with Conditional Score Distillation
papers.tldr: DD2 distills autoregressive image models into one-step generators using conditional scores, reducing the reported quality gap and training cost.

papers.title: Efficient Multimodal Dataset Distillation via Generative Models
papers.tldr: EDGE uses generative training with alignment and diversity losses to distill image–text datasets, reporting improved retrieval and an 18-fold speedup.

papers.title: FerretNet: Efficient Synthetic Image Detection via Local Pixel Dependencies
papers.tldr: FerretNet detects synthetic images through disrupted local pixel relationships, achieving 97.1% average accuracy across twenty-two generators with 1.1 million parameters.

papers.title: FlexVAR: Flexible Visual Autoregressive Modeling without Residual Prediction
papers.tldr: FlexVAR predicts complete image targets at each autoregressive step, enabling flexible resolutions, editing tasks, and inference budgets.

papers.title: GenColor: Generative and Expressive Color Enhancement with Pixel-Perfect Texture Preservation
papers.tldr: GenColor combines diffusion-generated color references with a dedicated transfer network to deliver expressive enhancement while preserving texture.

papers.title: Generative Perception of Shape and Material from Differential Motion
papers.tldr: A diffusion model represents ambiguous shape and material interpretations, then refines them using small object motions.

papers.title: Improved Training Technique for Shortcut Models
papers.tldr: iSM redesigns shortcut-model training to improve guidance, detail, and stability, with better reported image-generation results across sampling step counts.

papers.title: Increasing the Utility of Synthetic Images through Chamfer Guidance
papers.tldr: Chamfer Guidance uses a few real examples to improve synthetic-image diversity, downstream classifier accuracy, and sampling efficiency.

papers.title: Is Artificial Intelligence Generated Image Detection a Solved Problem?
papers.tldr: AIGIBench finds that strong controlled-test accuracy does not translate into reliable real-world AI-image detection for the 11 detectors evaluated.

papers.title: MLEP: Multi-granularity Local Entropy Patterns for Generalized AI-generated Image Detection
papers.tldr: MLEP uses multiscale entropy patterns from shuffled image patches to improve generated-image detection and generalization across 32 tested generators.

papers.title: NeuroRenderedFake: A Challenging Benchmark to Detect Fake Images Generated by Advanced Neural Rendering Methods
papers.tldr: NeuroRenderedFake benchmarks fake-image detectors across neural rendering and conventional generation, including cross-domain and spectral analyses.

papers.title: NFIG: Multi-Scale Autoregressive Image Generation via Frequency Ordering
papers.tldr: NFIG generates broad image structure before high-frequency detail, reporting improved quality and a 1.25-times speedup over VAR-d20 on ImageNet-256.

papers.title: PartCrafter: Structured 3D Mesh Generation via Compositional Latent Diffusion Transformers
papers.tldr: PartCrafter jointly generates distinct, coordinated 3D mesh parts from one image, including parts hidden from view.

papers.title: Plug-and-Play Context Feature Reuse for Efficient Masked Generation
papers.tldr: ReCAP reuses cached context features between full evaluations to speed up masked image generation with minimal reported fidelity loss.

papers.title: PocketSR: The Super-Resolution Expert in Your Pocket Mobiles
papers.tldr: PocketSR combines efficient encoding, gradual pruning, and feature distillation to deliver single-step image super-resolution with substantially reduced computation.

papers.title: Sparse Image Synthesis via Joint Latent and RoI Flow
papers.tldr: Jointly generating sparse image latents and their regions of interest delivers competitive image quality with reduced computation.

papers.title: STARFlow: Scaling Latent Normalizing Flows for High-resolution Image Synthesis
papers.tldr: STARFlow scales latent normalizing flows to high-resolution image synthesis while preserving exact continuous-space maximum-likelihood training.

papers.title: Stroke Patches: Customizable Artistic Image Styling Using Regression
papers.tldr: Procedurally generated stroke patches train a regression model to stylize images with explicit control over stroke composition and detail.

papers.title: ThermalGen: Style-Disentangled Flow-Based Generative Models for RGB-to-Thermal Image Translation
papers.tldr: ThermalGen combines flow-based RGB-to-thermal generation with diverse paired datasets to model variation across viewpoints, sensors, and environmental conditions.

papers.title: Towards Better & Faster Autoregressive Image Generation: From the Perspective of Entropy
papers.tldr: Entropy-guided temperature control and speculative acceptance rules improve autoregressive image quality and reduce reported inference costs.

papers.title: un$^2$CLIP: Improving CLIP's Visual Detail Capturing Ability via Inverting unCLIP
papers.tldr: un²CLIP improves CLIP's visual detail sensitivity by inverting an unCLIP generator while preserving alignment with the original text encoder.

papers.title: Understand Before You Generate: Self-Guided Training for Autoregressive Image Generation
papers.tldr: ST-AR adds self-supervised training objectives to improve autoregressive image understanding and generation without pretrained representation models.

papers.title: UtilGen: Utility-Centric Generative Data Augmentation with Dual-Level Task Adaptation
papers.tldr: UtilGen uses downstream feedback to adapt both a generator and its per-sample choices, producing synthetic data with greater reported training utility.

papers.title: WarpGAN: Warping-Guided 3D GAN Inversion with Style-Based Novel View Inpainting
papers.tldr: WarpGAN combines depth-guided warping with symmetry- and correspondence-based inpainting to improve new views generated from a single image.

papers.title: Concept Removal for Frontier Image Generative Models
papers.tldr: Replacing an internal bottleneck with a feature-structured transcoder enables selective concept removal while preserving image quality in evaluated frontier generators.

papers.title: DGS-Net: Distillation-Guided Gradient Surgery for CLIP Fine-Tuning in AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.tldr: DGS-Net reshapes CLIP fine-tuning gradients to preserve useful pretrained knowledge and improve AI-generated image detection across diverse generators.

papers.title: End-to-End Autoregressive Image Generation with 1D Semantic Tokenizer
papers.tldr: Jointly training an image tokenizer and autoregressive generator enables generation feedback to shape the representation and yields a reported unguided FID of 1.48.

papers.title: Is Generation Required for Data-Efficient Perception?
papers.tldr: Theory and synthetic-image experiments suggest that generative decoders can achieve compositional generalization with simpler enforceable biases than direct encoders.

papers.title: On the Anisotropy of Score-Based Generative Models
papers.tldr: Score Anisotropy Directions characterize architectural biases in score models and correlate with their downstream generative performance.

papers.title: Order within Chaos: Capturing Intrinsic Energy Anomalies for AI-Manipulated Image Forgery Localization
papers.tldr: FLAME localizes AI image edits using diffusion-related energy anomalies and reports strong performance on unseen generative architectures.

papers.title: PGC: Peak-Guided Calibration for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.tldr: PGC strengthens generated-image detection by using discriminative local feature peaks to calibrate global decisions.

papers.title: ProtoVAR: Efficient Dataset Distillation via Prototype-Guided Visual Autoregressive Modeling
papers.tldr: ProtoVAR combines multi-scale prototype-guided image generation with selection to produce effective compact training datasets at competitive computational cost.

papers.title: R1-SyntheticVL: Is Synthetic Data from Generative Models Ready for Multimodal Large Language Model?
papers.tldr: CADS combines collaborative generation, quality judgment, and adversarial context optimization to create synthetic multimodal data that improves R1-SyntheticVL.

papers.title: Self-Supervised Flow Matching for Scalable Multi-Modal Synthesis
papers.tldr: Self-Flow uses different noise levels across tokens to jointly learn semantic representations and generative capabilities without external supervision.

papers.title: SIGMA-PPG: Statistical-prior Informed Generative Masking Architecture for PPG Foundation Model
papers.tldr: SIGMA-PPG combines statistically guided adversarial masking and consistent waveform codes to improve PPG representations across downstream tasks.

papers.title: Where Detectors Fail: Probing Generative Space for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.tldr: PROBE uses detector feedback to generate realistic, difficult training examples that improve detection of images from unseen generators.
